NAAB Info dataset

bq_auth(email = "victorf2@illinois.edu")

projectid <- "dairy-168114"
query <- "
SELECT
    reg_id,
    id_number,
    breed,
    country,
    primary_naab_code,
    naab_codes,
    reg_name,
    birthdate,
    semen_release_date,
    genotype_information,
    sire_breed,
    sire_country,
    sire_id_number,
    dam_breed,
    dam_country,
    dam_id_number,
    mgs_breed,
    mgs_country,
    mgs_id_number,
    status
FROM
    CDCB_data.NAAB_Info
"

naab <- bq_project_query(projectid, query)
naab <- bq_table_download(naab)

naab <- naab |>
  mutate(birthdate = mdy(birthdate),
         yob = year(birthdate))

naab <- naab |>
  mutate(id_number = stringr::str_replace(id_number, "\\.", ""),
         id_number = str_pad(id_number, width = 12, side = "left", pad = "0"),
         reg_id = paste0(breed, country, id_number))
naab <- naab |>
  mutate(sire_id_number = stringr::str_replace(sire_id_number, "\\.", ""),
         sire_id_number = str_pad(sire_id_number, width = 12, side = "left", pad = "0"),
         sire_id = paste0(sire_breed, sire_country, sire_id_number))

naab$sire_id <- replace(naab$sire_id, naab$sire_id == "NANANA", NA)

naab <- naab |>
  mutate(mgs_id_number = stringr::str_replace(mgs_id_number, "\\.", ""),
         mgs_id_number = str_pad(mgs_id_number, width = 12, side = "left", pad = "0"),
         mgs_id = paste0(mgs_breed, mgs_country, mgs_id_number))

naab$mgs_id <- replace(naab$mgs_id, naab$mgs_id == "NANANA", NA)

naab <- naab |>
  mutate(dam_id_number = stringr::str_replace(dam_id_number, "\\.", ""),
         dam_id_number = str_pad(dam_id_number, width = 12, side = "left", pad = "0"),
         dam_id = paste0(dam_breed, dam_country, dam_id_number))

naab$dam_id <- replace(naab$dam_id, naab$dam_id == "NANANA", NA)

AISS data

query <- "SELECT

  pta_pl as pta_pl,
  pta_dpr as pta_dpr,
  pta_hcr as pta_hcr,
  pta_ccr as pta_ccr,
  pta_liv as pta_liv,
  pta_ssb as pta_ssb,
  pta_dsb as pta_dsb,

  pta_stature as pta_stature,

  pta_rear_legs_rear as pta_rear_legs_rear,

  pta_rear_udder_height as pta_rear_udder_height,
  pta_rear_udder_width as pta_rear_udder_width,
  pta_udder_cleft as pta_udder_cleft,
  pta_udder_depth as pta_udder_depth,
  pta_teat_front_place as pta_teat_front_place,
  pta_teat_rear_place as pta_teat_rear_place,
  pta_teat_length as pta_teat_length,
  pta_mobility,

FROM
  CDCB_data.NAAB_AISS
"

naab_aiss <- bq_project_query(projectid, query)
naab_aiss <- bq_table_download(naab_aiss)

naab_aiss <- naab_aiss %>%
  separate(period, into = c("year", "per_num"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(dob = ymd(dob),
         yob = year(dob))

naab_aiss <- naab_aiss |>
  mutate(id_number = stringr::str_replace(id_number, "\\.", ""),
         id_number = str_pad(id_number, width = 12, side = "left", pad = "0"),
         reg_id = paste0(breed, country, id_number))

How old are bulls when they are proven for the first time?:

Genomic-tested bulls are proven mostly at ages 1 or 2, daughter-proven bulls wait until they are 4-6 years old. The average lifespan of a bovine is 10-12 years old https://livestock.extension.wisc.edu/articles/when-to-cull-bulls. We can assume that bulls 10 years and older are just frozen semen samples.

Other thing to note, we have 92 bulls tested before they reach one year of age.

CDN data

cdn <- read.csv(paste0(folder, "/Box/Dairy Industry in US/Data/Network data/cdn_data.csv"))
naab_aiss <- inner_join(naab_aiss, cdn[c("reg_id_alt", "inbreeding", "relationship")], by = join_by(reg_id == reg_id_alt))

Genomic tested animals are on average more inbred than daughter-proven bulls.

naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(status) |> 
  summarise(inb = mean(inbreeding, na.rm = TRUE), 
            N = n())

Inbreeding rates are increasing for all classes of bulls, in all cases it increases significantly after the introduction of genomic testing. Here I show the values of the first proof of each animal.

The distribution of inbreeding coefficients is skewed to the left, reflecting a higher average inbreeding, as evidenced by its mean

naab_aiss |> 
  filter(!is.na(status) & !is.na(inbreeding) & inbreeding > 0) |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = inbreeding, group = status)) + 
  geom_density(aes(fill = status), alpha = 0.35) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  xlab("Inbreeding Coefficient") + ylab("Density")

Changes in Net Merit by type of proof and year of birth

naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(status) & year > 2008 & year < 2018) |>
  group_by(year, status) |>
  summarise(NM = mean(NM, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  #pivot_wider(id_cols = year, names_from = "status", values_from = "NM") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = NM, group = status)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = status)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = status)) +
  theme_classic()
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'year'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.

  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(status) & year > 2007) |>

  summarise(TPI = mean(TPI, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = year, names_from = "status", values_from = "TPI") |>

  select(c(year, dA, dG, dF)) |>
  rename(A = dA, F = dF, G = dG) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = A:F, names_to = "status", values_to = "dTPI") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = dTPI, group = status)) +

Characterizing early adopters

Farm names

farm_names <- read_csv(paste0(folder, "/Box/WDE Results/bull_and_farm_names.csv"))
## Rows: 166057 Columns: 3
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (3): reg_id, naab_code, farm_name
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
farm_names |>
  distinct(reg_id, .keep_all = TRUE) ->
  farm_names

naab_aiss <- left_join(naab_aiss, farm_names, by = join_by(reg_id == reg_id))
naab_aiss |> 
  select(-naab_code.y) |>
  rename(naab_code = naab_code.x) ->
  naab_aiss
rm(cdn)

Inbreeding coefficient of early adopters

eadopt <- naab_aiss |>
  filter(status == "G" & yob < 2010) |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

eadopt |>
  group_by(yob) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(inbreeding, na.rm = TRUE), 
            max = max(inbreeding, na.rm = TRUE), 
            min = min(inbreeding, na.rm = TRUE), 
            N = n())
naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(yob > 2005 & !is.na(status)) |>
  group_by(yob, status) |>
  summarise(farm_name = n_distinct(farm_name, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = yob, names_from = "status", values_from = "farm_name")
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'yob'. You can override using the `.groups`
## argument.

Marketing/stud codes

companies <- read_csv("../../data/company_info.csv")
## Rows: 534 Columns: 10
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (9): company_name, parent_company, address, city, state, zip, phone_fax,...
## dbl (1): primary_stud_code
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(yob > 2005 & !is.na(status)) |>
  group_by(yob, status) |>
  summarise(n_studs = n_distinct(primary_stud_code, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = yob, names_from = "status", values_from = "n_studs") ->
  nstuds
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'yob'. You can override using the `.groups`
## argument.
kable(nstuds)

companies |>
  mutate(date_1 = str_split(assigned, " ", simplify = TRUE)[,2],
         date_2 = str_split(assigned, " ", simplify = TRUE)[,5]) |>
  separate(date_1, into = c("assigned_date", "temp"), sep = ";") |>
  select(-temp) |>
  separate(date_2, into = c("end_date", "temp"), sep = ";") |>
  select(-temp) |>
  mutate(assigned_date = mdy(assigned_date),
         end_date = mdy(end_date)) |>
  select(-assigned) ->
  companies
companies |> 
 arrange(assigned_date) |> 
  select(-c(notes, parent_company)) |> 
  mutate(reg_year = year(assigned_date)) |>
  group_by(reg_year) |>
  summarise(N = n())
naab_aiss <- left_join(naab_aiss, companies, by = "primary_stud_code")
naab_aiss |>
  mutate(reg_year = year(assigned_date)) |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(year_proof %in% 2009:2012 & !is.na(status)) |>
  group_by(status, reg_year) |>
  summarise(N = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = reg_year, names_from = "status", values_from = "N") |>
  arrange(reg_year)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'status'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
naab_aiss |>
  mutate(parent_company = ifelse(is.na(parent_company), company_name, parent_company)) |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(year_proof > 2009 & year_proof < 2014 & !is.na(status)) |>
  tab(year_proof, parent_company, status) |>
  select(c(year_proof, parent_company, status, Freq.)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(year_proof, parent_company), names_from = "status", values_from = "Freq.") |>
  data.frame()

Large vs. small firms: supports the intensive-margin hypothesis, large firms adopted G earlier and to a larger extent

Number of firms per year

naab_aiss |>
  filter(status %in% c("A", "G")) |>
  mutate(parent_company = ifelse(is.na(parent_company), company_name, parent_company))  |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(year_proof) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(year, parent_company) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(num_firms = 1:n()) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  select(year, num_firms) |>
  filter(year < 2019) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = num_firms)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2009, color = "red", linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic()
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'

Numbers of animals per firm and year explodes after GT is introduced!

naab_aiss |>
  mutate(parent_company = ifelse(is.na(parent_company), company_name, parent_company)) |>
  group_by(parent_company, year) |>
  mutate(num_bulls = 1:n()) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  select(c(year, parent_company, num_bulls)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(parent_company %in% c("ABS Global", "Genex", "Select Sires", 
                               "Semex Alliance", "STgenetics", "Alta Genetics") &
           year > 2000 & year < 2021) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = num_bulls, group = parent_company)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = parent_company)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = parent_company)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2009, color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2019, 3)) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Number of new bulls released")

naab_aiss |>
  mutate(parent_company = ifelse(is.na(parent_company), company_name, parent_company)) |>
  group_by(parent_company, year) |>
  mutate(num_bulls = 1:n()) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  select(c(year, parent_company, num_bulls)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(parent_company %in% c("Hawkeye Breeders", "International Protein Sires", "JLG Enterprises", 
                               "Jetstream Genetics", "Synetics", "Viking Genetics") &
           year < 2021) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = num_bulls, group = parent_company)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = parent_company)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = parent_company)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2009, color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2019, 3)) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Number of new bulls released")

naab_aiss |>
  mutate(parent_company = ifelse(is.na(parent_company), company_name, parent_company),
         size = case_when(
           parent_company %in% c("ABS Global", "Genex", "Select Sires", 
                               "Semex Alliance", "STgenetics", "Alta Genetics") ~ "Large companies",
           parent_company %in% c("Hawkeye Breeders", "International Protein Sires", "JLG Enterprises", 
                               "Jetstream Genetics", "Synetics", "Viking Genetics") ~ "Small companies")) |>
  filter(!is.na(size) & year < 2021) |>
  group_by(size, parent_company, year) |>
  mutate(num_bulls = 1:n()) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  select(c(year, parent_company, num_bulls)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = num_bulls, group = parent_company)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = parent_company)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = parent_company)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2009, color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Number of new bulls released") +
  facet_wrap(.~size, scales = "free_y")

Defining superstars

connections <- naab[, c('reg_id', 'sire_id')] |>
  distinct(reg_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
names(connections) <- c("reg_id", "sire_id_g0")
connect <- naab[, c('reg_id', 'sire_id')] |>
  distinct(reg_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cnt = 1
ix = 0

while(cnt != 0){
  connect_temp <- connect
  names(connect_temp) <- c(paste0('sire_id_g', as.character(ix)), paste0('sire_id_g', as.character(ix+1)))
  connections <- left_join(connections, connect_temp, by = paste0('sire_id_g', as.character(ix)))
  ix <- ix + 1
  cnt <- table(connections[, paste0('sire_id_g', as.character(ix))]) |>
    dim()
  print(cnt)
  rm(connect_temp)
}

pedigree |>
  group_by(sire_id) |>
  summarise(w = sum(weight)) |>
  arrange(desc(w))
alpha <- qnorm(0.99)
naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(year_proof) |>
  summarise(age_m = mean(age),
            age_sd = mean(age), 
            N = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year_proof, y = age_m)) + 
  geom_point(color = "lightblue", size = 3) + 
  geom_line(color = "lightblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = age_m-alpha*age_sd/sqrt(N), 
                  ymax = age_m+alpha*age_sd/sqrt(N)),
              alpha = 0.35) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept =  2009, linetype = 2) + 
  xlab("Year of first proof") + 
  ylab("Average age at first proof") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2020, 5)) + 
  ylim(0, 8)

naab_aiss |>
  group_by(reg_id) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(year_proof) |>
  summarise(TPI = mean(TPI, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year_proof, y = TPI)) + 
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 3) + 
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept =  2009, linetype = 2) + 
  xlab("Year of first proof") + 
  ylab("Average TPI") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2020, 5))
